goal: Replace main-screen's partial Tokens and Activity lists (each with an in-app 'View all' button leading to a full-list screen) with two tabs -- Tokens and Activity -- directly on the main screen, each showing its full content inline, so fewer in-app full-list screens need to be built and maintained.
outcome: MainScreenView.tsx renders a Tokens/Activity tab control in place of today's two stacked partial sections. The Tokens tab shows the complete token list (same TokenRow rendering, no 5/10-item truncation). The Activity tab shows only the 10 most recent activity entries plus a 'View all' action that opens https://lunar.arweave.net/#/explorer/<wallet.address> in a new browser tab/window (external link, not an in-app route) -- replacing today's in-app activity subView. Clicking an individual ActivityRow opens https://lunar.arweave.net/#/explorer/<entry.txId> in a new tab/window instead of any in-app transaction-detail view. App.tsx's activity subView route and the now-unused apps/extension/entrypoints/popup/activity/** screen (ActivityView.tsx, TransactionDetail.tsx) are removed since lunar.arweave.net now serves both jobs; onViewAllActivity is removed from MainScreenViewProps in favor of the in-component external-link behavior, and the already-unused onViewAllTokens no-op is removed the same way. Token amount/date formatting, loading skeleton, and empty-state behavior carry over unchanged from the current partial lists.

requirements.statement: Both 'View all' style actions and every individual ActivityRow open lunar.arweave.net in a new browser tab/window (e.g. window.open with a noopener target), never an in-app navigation -- this is the mechanism that lets the in-app activity/transaction-detail screens be deleted rather than kept as a second code path.
The Activity tab caps its inline list at the 10 most recent entries (state.activity.entries.slice(0, 10)); the Tokens tab shows the full token list with no cap.

Tab switching is local UI state in MainScreenView -- no new ProtocolMap method, no new runtime.send call; both tabs are fed by the same getBalance/getTokenBalances/getActivity load() call already in this component.

apps/extension/entrypoints/popup/activity/** and its App.tsx subView route are deleted as part of this change, not left as dead code, since the tabs' external-link behavior fully replaces what that screen did.
Main screen shows a Tokens/Activity tab control; the Tokens tab lists every token in state.tokenBalances (not just the first N); the Activity tab lists at most the 10 most recent activity entries.

Activity tab's 'View all' opens https://lunar.arweave.net/#/explorer/<wallet.address> in a new tab; clicking any listed ActivityRow opens https://lunar.arweave.net/#/explorer/<txId> in a new tab -- neither navigates in-app.
apps/extension/entrypoints/popup/activity/** no longer exists and App.tsx no longer has an 'activity' subView case; the extension still builds and no other screen references the deleted files.

pnpm vitest run main-screen pricing passes; pnpm vitest run arweave ao pricing activity send receive passes (activity handler tests unaffected by UI deletion); pnpm tsc -p packages/core --noEmit passes; pnpm wxt build succeeds.
